name: Kasai Kumiko
source: A first-year girl at Inamura Academy who grew up in family with problems, having only one parent. Before meeting [url=/c5398]Ai[/url], she wanted to become the boss of Inamura Academy, however, after their meeting, she started respecting her completely and joined her gang. She hates the school uniform and would like to wear a jersey instead.
